prompt: A image reveal where the main image is already on the screen blured and quickly unblurs, followed by all the elements coming up and down, with some bounciness when it makes sense. It shuold take the real estate image itself, and the real estate agent image to place on the bottom avatar corner and the company logo to place on the bottom right. The image should fill the whole space and then be covered by the rest of the elements, and the background shuold be transparent. Follow the reference image. The agent logo and info and company needs to be slightly bigger.
